check_mask: check that a token sequence contains the correct number of placeholder blocks for image tokens
check_special_vision_token: check that input data contains the correct special vision tokens at expected positions
initialize_vision_tokens: initialize vision token embeddings by inserting image placeholders into a token buffer for inference
VisionExit: build a Flax module that spatially avg-pools vision soft tokens to a required output length
SigLiPFromPatches: build a SigLIP vision encoder that processes patched images into soft tokens for multimodal models
